name: Metabolic Research Set
description: MOTS-c, SR-3RT and SR-TSM: three compounds studied in metabolic and energy-regulation research.

name: Metabolic Starter Set
description: Smaller sizes of the Metabolic Research Set: MOTS-c, SR-3RT and SR-TSM.

name: Mitochondrial Research Set
description: SR-31, MOTS-c and NAD+: compounds studied in mitochondrial function and cellular energy research.

name: Mitochondrial Starter Set
description: Smaller sizes of the Mitochondrial Research Set: SR-31, MOTS-c and NAD+.

name: Circadian Research Set
description: Pinealon, DSIP and SR-TSM: compounds studied in circadian-rhythm and neuroendocrine research.

name: Oxidative Stress Research Set
description: Glutathione, FOXO4-DRI and NAD+: compounds studied in oxidative-stress and cellular-senescence research.

name: Oxidative Stress Starter Set
description: Smaller sizes of the Oxidative Stress Research Set: Glutathione, FOXO4-DRI and NAD+.

name: Skin Research Set
description: GHK-Cu, Glutathione and SR-TSM: compounds studied in skin and collagen research.

name: Skin Starter Set
description: Smaller sizes of the Skin Research Set: GHK-Cu, Glutathione and SR-TSM.

name: Tissue Repair Research Set
description: BPC-157, TB-500 and GHK-Cu: the three most widely studied compounds in tissue-repair research.

name: Immune Research Set
description: Thymosin Alpha-1, KPV and Thymalin: compounds studied in immune-signaling research.

name: Neuropeptide Research Set
description: Semax, Selank and PE 22-28: neuropeptides studied in cognitive and neurological research.
